title: Bottom Plate Strip Vacuuming behind Removed Baseboard, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
On a Water Damage Mitigation job the bottom plate behind removed baseboard is vacuumed as a strip in the final cleaning, adding a vacuumed plate area to the final HEPA vacuuming line.

## Standard
The bottom plate behind removed baseboard is vacuumed as a strip: on a Class 3 or Class 4 job carrying baseboard removal lines the vacuumed plate area is the linear feet on those lines times 1 foot, on a Class 2 job carrying baseboard removal lines it is those linear feet times 0.5 foot (half a foot), and in any other case no plate strip is vacuumed under this standard.

## Table
| IICRC class on the job record | Baseboard removal lines | Vacuumed plate area |
|---|---|---|
| Class 3 or Class 4 | yes | baseboard linear feet multiplied by 1 foot |
| Class 2 | yes | baseboard linear feet multiplied by 0.5 foot |
| Class 1 | yes | none under this standard |
| any | no | none under this standard |

## Worked figures (hypothetical baseboard run of 118 linear feet)
- Class 4: 118 square feet of plate strip.
- Class 2: 59 square feet.
